products_prompt: Create a 4 by 2 transparent sprite atlas of eight cohesive hand-painted grocery icons: produce bag, bread loaf, cereal box, wrapped sandwich, bottled drink, microwave meal tray, ceramic mug, and four-meal multipack. One centered object per equal square cell, no text, brands, dividers, labels, or background.
emblem_prompt: Create a transparent decorative Town Grocery interface emblem showing a red-handled chrome wire shopping cart with produce, bread, and a blue bottle, framed by a restrained green leaf wreath and cream/sage circular badge, with no text.
checkerboard_cleanup: Both source sheets were refined with transparent output enabled; the original non-transparent generations remain in this directory as *-source.png.
